data.narrative:
Skapion is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by defense industry veterans including ex-Rafael (Iron Dome, David's Sling) leadership. The valuation analysis draws on a comp set of 10 private and 2 public frontier-defense firms, including peers UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI at Seed and Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses Skapion's $36M total raised as a proxy base value, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, implying $90M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $1.0B (UFORCE, Seed). The peer distribution reflects material heterogeneity within the defense-tech category.

Triangulating these methods produces a supported range of $76M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $245M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound; the peer-median anchors the upper bound. Key uncertainties include the stage classification of comparable companies—Skapion's readiness relative to labeled peers remains unspecified—and the wide dispersion in peer valuations ($875M spread), which may reflect differences in product maturity, customer validation, or investor appetite rather than pure sector dynamics. Additional data on Skapion's revenue, customer traction, or technical milestones would narrow this range materially.
